name: Eureka
description: Australian blueberry cultivar from the Mountain Blue breeding programme, discovered as a single plant selection in 2008 at Lindendale, New South Wales. The name is also used as an umbrella brand for several distinct Mountain Blue cultivars, which are not the same object as this cultivar.

attributes.code_confidence: Attributed from trade and market sources; IP Australia's synonym field for the corresponding PBR record reads 'N/A', so there is no registry-level confirmation that the brand name Eureka maps to 'Ridley 1403'.
attributes.origin: single plant 'M08-14-03' selected from 100 seedlings, Lindendale NSW
attributes.naming_hazard: Eureka the cultivar must not be merged with Eureka the umbrella brand, nor with Eureka Sunrise, Eureka Sunset, Eureka Dawn, Eureka Gold or Eureka Maxx.

traits.asserted_by: United States Patent and Trademark Office

traits.value: Patent describes a good sweetness and acidity balance; the owner separately claims exceptional sweetness and a crisp, juicy texture
